title: Terence Tao: Math 2.0 [pdf]
why_read: Terence Tao discussing how AI and collaborative tools are changing mathematical research practice is a substantive essay from a top mathematician.
analysis: This is a talk or paper by Terence Tao, a leading mathematician, exploring how AI tools, formal proof assistants, and collaborative platforms could reshape how mathematics gets done, dubbed 'Math 2.0'. It matters because Tao has been an early and thoughtful adopter of tools like Lean and GPT-based assistants in actual research, so his perspective carries real weight. The high comment count suggests substantive debate about AI's role in formal reasoning and discovery, which is relevant to anyone tracking AI-assisted science.
